text:
maya: heads-up: canary promotion blocked by shard prefetch throttle on build 8420 at 09:10 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/8420
ravi: logs show repeated 429/timeout from artifact proxy. snippet:
```
prefetch shard-3 -> 429 Too Many Requests
curl: (28) timeout after 15s
```
deploy-bot: auto-retries 5/5 exhausted, promotion paused.
tess: change-window at 09:30 PT  do we wait for proxy to cool or pin previous digest?
omar: if proxy clears in 10-15m we can retry; product demo at 09:40 so prefer pin to be safe.
sre-oncall: recommending manual promote of last-known-good sha256:77aa33 to meet window, quarantine 8420 for follow-up.
maya: decision: promote previous digest. @deploy-bot run promote and keep build quarantined.
deploy-bot: running: `deploybot promote --env=canary --image=sha256:77aa33 --reason="prefetch throttle build 8420"`
deploy-bot: promote OK, canary now on sha256:77aa33, routing updated.
tess: I'll update release notes and file bug for artifact-proxy throttle.
ravi: scheduling re-run of artifact prefetch after proxy backoff; we can attempt rebuild if artifacts recover.
maya: change-window met. opening follow-up ticket to track root cause and postmortem if repeats. :thumbsup:
